thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API us-east-1 p95/p99 spike detected — queue growth on frontend-hosted-queue (queue depth 14k, inflight GPU tasks 100% of pool)

sara (oncall): I'm on it. paging infra and provisioner. tagging @miguel for provisioner logs.

miguel: seeing repeated errors from provisioner: `rate limit exceeded create_instances` and `quotaExceeded: insufficient quota for GPU vms` — retries backing off.

jess: customers reporting timeouts. support dashboard shows 47 distinct orgs with elevated 5xxs in last 10m. top impacted: analytics-saas, convoai.

arjun: p95 generation latency jumped from 180ms to 2.4s, p99 at 9.1s for hosted.text.generate. Errors: 504 gateway and request timeouts in our LB.

kevin: autoscaler attempted scale +30 GPUs but hit cloud quota/responsive pool creation throttles. Provisioner logs: 
```
2026-03-15T03:12:14Z provisioner: request_create_pool(pool=prod-us-east-1-1, gpus=30) -> 429
2026-03-15T03:12:18Z provisioner: retrying backoff 8s
2026-03-15T03:13:03Z provisioner: quotaExceeded: project quota GPU_V100_PER_REGION
```

linda: routing policy shows 95% of traffic pinned to prod-us-east-1 due to region affinity + sticky routing from session cache. we can shift non-locked sessions to prod-eu-west-1 as short-term relief.

sara (oncall): mitigation plan (initial): 1) open short-term rate limits per-org 2) enable fallback to smaller model variants for non-critical routes 3) start cross-region reroute for non-PII requests 4) escalate quota request with cloud ops 

miguel: starting cross-region reroute for anonymous/free-tier first. I'm flipping the route rule now: `route:set prod-us-east-1 -> prod-eu-west-1 where session.pii=false and account.tier!=enterprise`

support-bot: Notifying affected customers: analytics-saas (contact: ops@analytics.com), convoai (contact: oncall@convo.ai) — automated email queued.

jess: enabling request-shedding token bucket for bursty customers: `rlimit per_org 200r/s` for 10m window. applying now.

arjun: also enabling KV prefix-cache for common system prompts and completions for the top 300 frequent prompts — should drop token evals by ~12% and reduce load.

kevin: manual pool creation is stuck on cloud side — cloud support says they're rate-limited by quota backend. ETA unclear (>30m).

sara (oncall): fallback routing live for 38% of requests -> eu-west. early signal: queue depth in us-east dropped 22% in first 60s. p95 improved to 1.1s from 2.4s for rerouted subset. overall p99 still high.

miguel: deploy logs show a handful of sessions that can't be rerouted due to pinned context in redis. I'll run a quick sweep to evict non-critical pins: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "session:*:pin" | xargs -n 1 redis-cli del` but doing it carefully.

linda: note: enterprise customers (10 orgs) remain pinned to us-east for data residency — we need to avoid broad shedding that impacts them.

jess: we enabled model-variant downgrade on the edge for non-enterprise routes: big-model-v1 -> medium-model-v1-quantized with same API contract. latency drops, cost down ~40%.

arjun: adding a temporary timeout reduction to 6s at the frontend to free up stuck connections and help backpressure.

incident-bot: SYSTEM: New oncall assignment scheduled: sara -> miguel at 04:00 UTC (handoff).

sara (oncall): preparing handoff notes for miguel: 
- current state: queue handled partly by reroute, provisioner blocked by quota, manual create pending.
- mitigations applied: per-org rate-limits, KV caching, model downgrades, cross-region reroute for non-PII, shorter timeouts.
- impact: ~47 orgs saw elevated 5xxs; ~12k queued requests at peak; now 9.4k.

miguel: I've started a targeted `evict-pinned-sessions` job for accounts in free-tier only. will monitor errors.

kevin: cloud quota team acknowledged a support ticket but no immediate quota grant. asked for escalation to risk/ops.

jess: running synthetic load against eu-west path shows it's healthy but approaching 70% of its pool if we push more traffic. we should avoid saturating eu-west.

linda: suggestion: enable adaptive sampling to reduce token lengths for top percentile requests: `sampling.cut_fraction=0.25` for non-enterprise. This reduces token count and helps overall throughput.

arjun: enabled sampling change. watch TTLs.

support-bot: customer impact update: 11 customers still reporting >10% error rate, 3 on enterprise flagged for individual mitigation.

sara (oncall): note for post-incident: we need a playbook for quota-blocked autoscaler: fallback strategies, pre-warmed standby pools, and SLA communications.

miguel: starting a manual pooled VM creation in a partner region (ap-south) that has unused quota. will need config tweaks for model artifacts sync. copying configs: `rsync -avz /models/prod bigmodel`

kevin: provisioning in ap-south succeeded for 12 GPUs. will start evicting lower priority tasks onto that pool.

jess: after shifting low-priority jobs to ap-south and downgrading model variants, end-to-end p95 across hosted-api dropped to 480ms and p99 to 1.9s. error rate halved.

sara (oncall): customer communications: send interim status to the impacted orgs summarizing mitigations and ETA for full recovery. cc @jess for technical summary.

support-bot: Draft status posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation in US-EAST affecting hosted API; mitigations applied; cross-region routing and rate-limits in effect. More updates in 15m."

miguel: handoff note for next oncall (miguel -> arjun at 05:00 UTC): watch provisioner backoff, cloud quota ticket, model sync to ap-south, queue depth trending.

arjun: I'll own the long-tail cleanup and postmortem items: instrument more granular per-route latency + error metrics and add a synthetic probe for sticky sessions to detect reroute failures.

sara (oncall): thanks team. staying on until handoff window. quick checklist before handing to miguel in 20m: 1) confirm queued requests trending down 2) ensure no runaway enterprise shedding 3) confirm status page update.

kevin: all good on my side — monitoring quota escalation. next step is backlog drain policy: `backlog.trim(rate=500r/s)` scheduled for 30m if queue not under 2k.

jess: we should add a temporary canary fallback in SDK that routes to medium-model for clients on older SDK versions (they can't opt-in server-side). filing a hotfix PR.

support-bot: UPDATE: error rate decreased by 47% over 20 minutes. ongoing mitigations holding.

sara (oncall): handing off to miguel now — full notes above. miguel, take the pager. I'll be available for questions. :white_check_mark:

miguel: taking over. will monitor provisioning and queue. thanks all. :handshake:

-- end of thread --
